builds.name: DK Fiend Standard
builds.description: The standard Undead build. Death Knight opener with mass Ghouls for early creeping and lumber, transitioning into Crypt Fiends and Obsidian Statues at T2. Lich second hero for Frost Nova burst.
strategyPoints: Open DK for Unholy Aura speed and Death Coil sustain â€” creep efficiently to level 3
Rush to tier 2 around 5:30â€“6:00, start Fiend production immediately from Crypt
Lich second hero with Frost Nova â€” obliterates clumped melee and provides burst damage
Add Obsidian Statues at T2 for mana/HP regen sustain in prolonged fights
T3 for Orb of Corruption on DK â€” armor debuff makes Fiend focus fire lethal
Wins against: most standard openers, BM Grunt builds, AM Rifle builds
Loses to: very fast Orc harassment preventing creeping, well-timed NE Bear timing pushes

t2.goal: Lich second hero, add Statues for sustain, continue Fiend production

t3.goal: Orb of Corruption on DK, Destroyers if facing casters
t3.notes: Standard UD T3 for the orb â€” not a T3-focused build

conditionalBranches.condition: Facing mass casters (HU Priests, NE Dryads)
conditionalBranches.adjustment: Rush Destroyers for Devour Magic
Push with DK/Lich + 5 Fiends before expo pays off

builds.name: DK Destroyer
builds.description: DK Fiend opener that priorities a fast T3 for Destroyer tech. Destroyers' Devour Magic hard-counters caster-heavy armies like NE Dryads or HU Priests.
strategyPoints: Standard DK Ghoul T1 — creep efficiently, build 4-5 Ghouls before teching to Fiends at T2
Lich second with Frost Nova for burst damage in engagements
Rush T3 for Destroyers â€” they eat buffs/debuffs and counter caster compositions
Destroyers absorb mana for healing â€” self-sustaining vs magic-heavy armies
Dark Ranger third hero â€” Silence shuts down NE bears/dryads, Black Arrow raises skeletons
Wins against: NE Dryad/Bear compositions, HU Priest/Breaker armies
Loses to: fast timing pushes that hit before Destroyers are online

t2.goal: Lich second, Statues for sustain, begin T3 upgrade immediately

t3.goal: Destroyers ASAP â€” Devour Magic is the win condition
t3.notes: Rushed Destroyers specifically to counter caster-heavy compositions

conditionalBranches.condition: NE goes mass bears instead of casters
conditionalBranches.adjustment: Skip Destroyers, mass Fiends with Web upgrade instead
Destroyers double as anti-air, prioritize Frost Armor on them

builds.name: BM Wind Rider
builds.description: Blademaster opener with heavy early harassment, transitioning into Wind Rider air superiority. Denies expansion and wins on economic disruption.
strategyPoints: BM's Mirror Image and Wind Walk make him nearly impossible to catch early game
Constant worker harassment forces UD to divert Acolytes and delays expansion
Wind Riders fly over Undead army positioning and attack buildings directly
Shadow Hunter second hero for Serpent Wards and Healing Wave sustain
Wins against: UD expansions that come too early or are poorly defended
Loses to: well-timed Lich Nova + DK coil that kills Wind Riders before critical mass

t1.goal: BM harass enemy base, Grunts for creeping

t2.goal: Shadow Hunter second, start Wind Rider production from Bestiary

t3.goal: Mass Wind Riders with Envenomed Weapons upgrade
t3.notes: T3 mainly for unit upgrades â€” army is already Wind Riders at T2

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Add Bat Riders to counter anti-air, or pivot to ground Raiders
Expand yourself and outscale â€” WRs can harass expansions

builds.name: FS Headhunter
builds.description: Far Seer opener with Headhunters and Shamans. The most versatile Orc opener â€” Bloodlust makes Headhunters burst targets down, Hex and Purge shut down enemy heroes.
strategyPoints: Far Seer Spirit Wolves are free tanks that absorb Death Coil and Holy Light
Headhunters with Berserker Upgrade have extreme DPS under Bloodlust
Shaman Hex removes key enemy units from fights for several seconds
Purge removes Unholy Aura speed, Brilliance Aura, Devotion Aura
Tauren Chieftain second â€” Endurance Aura stacks with Bloodlust for insane attack speed
Wins against: DK openers that rely on Death Coil micro, standard AM play
Loses to: fast T2 pushes that arrive before Shamans get Bloodlust upgrade

t1.goal: FS + 2-3 Headhunters, creep with wolves tanking

t2.goal: TC second hero, Shamans for Bloodlust + Purge, continue HH production

t3.goal: Master Bloodlust upgrade, Kodo Beasts for Devour
t3.notes: T3 mainly for Shaman Master Training â€” the army composition stays HH/Shaman

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Headhunters already counter air â€” add more and skip Shamans
Add Kodo Beasts â€” Devour removes key enemy units permanently

builds.name: BM Grunt Standard
builds.description: Blademaster opener into mass Grunts for an aggressive ground push. BM harasses workers while Grunts pressure the front door. Transitions into Spirit Walkers or Raiders at T2.
strategyPoints: BM Wind Walk into enemy base for worker kills while Grunts creep
Mass Grunts are cost-effective and trade well in melee engagements
Shadow Hunter second â€” Healing Wave keeps Grunts alive in sustained fights
Push timing at 50-60 food with BM3 + SH + 5-6 Grunts
Wins against: greedy NE fast expansions, NE Archer openers without Huntresses
Loses to: well-positioned Ancient Protectors, NE mass Huntress with Moon Glaive

t1.goal: BM + 4-5 Grunts, harass with BM while Grunts creep

t2.goal: SH second, Spirit Walkers for Disenchant, Raiders for Ensnare

t3.goal: Taurens if game goes late â€” Pulverize is devastating in melee
t3.notes: Usually decided at T2 timing push â€” T3 is the fallback

conditionalBranches.condition: NE builds Ancient Protectors at expansion
conditionalBranches.adjustment: Don't force it â€” take your own expansion and outscale
Add Headhunters or transition to Wind Riders

builds.name: AM Caster
builds.description: Archmage into Footmen, then Priests and Spell Breakers at T2. The dominant Human build in the current meta. Inner Fire buffs Footmen, Spell Steal counters summons.
strategyPoints: Archmage Water Elementals trade well early — micro them aggressively
Footmen tank while casters deal damage from behind
Priests with Inner Fire are the core — buff Footmen damage and Heal sustains
Spell Breakers counter enemy summons and provide spell immunity
Mountain King second for Storm Bolt stun — shuts down enemy hero plays

t1.goal: AM + Footmen for creeping, transition to Rifles

t2.goal: MK second hero, Arcane Sanctum for Priests + Spell Breakers

t3.goal: Castle for Knight production and Master Training upgrades
t3.notes: T3 is optional â€” many games end at T2 with Rifle/Caster army

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Add Flying Machines from Workshop, Riflemen already counter air
More Spell Breakers with Control Magic â€” steal their summons

builds.name: AM Rifle
builds.description: Archmage into Footmen transitioning to Riflemen and Sorceresses. Rifle range controls space, Slow from Sorceresses kites melee armies.
strategyPoints: Archmage Water Elementals are free units that trade well early â€” micro them aggressively
Brilliance Aura gives permanent mana regen to all nearby units â€” enables Blizzard spam
Riflemen have the longest range of any T1 ground unit â€” kite melee effectively
Mountain King second for Storm Bolt stun and Bash â€” shuts down enemy hero plays
Priests with Inner Fire buff Riflemen damage, Heal sustains the army between fights
Spell Breakers at T2 â€” Control Magic steals summons, Spell Immunity blocks nukes
Wins against: most standard openers, NE Archer builds, Orc Grunt builds
Loses to: mass Mountain Giants with Taunt, UD Destroyer transitions

t1.goal: AM + Footmen for creeping, transition to Rifles

t2.goal: MK second hero, Arcane Sanctum for Priests + Spell Breakers

t3.goal: Castle for Knight production and Master Training upgrades
t3.notes: T3 is optional â€” many games end at T2 with Rifle/Caster army

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Add Flying Machines from Workshop, Riflemen already counter air
More Spell Breakers with Control Magic â€” steal their summons

builds.name: MK Fast Expand
builds.description: Mountain King first into fast expansion. Storm Bolt stuns harassers, Bash provides melee dominance. Build army to 60 food then upgrade to Castle for Knights.
strategyPoints: MK first â€” Storm Bolt is the best anti-harass stun in the game
Fast expansion with militia to defend the new Town Hall
MK + Footmen + Rifles can defend expo against most early aggression
AM second for Brilliance Aura mana sustain and Water Elementals
Build to 60 food on two bases, then tech to Castle for Knights
Paladin third hero for Holy Light healing and Divine Shield safety
Wins against: opponents who don't punish the expansion window
Loses to: fast timing attacks that hit before the expansion pays off

t1.goal: MK + Footmen, scout for expansion timing

t2.goal: Expand, AM second, Rifles + Priests for army sustain

t3.goal: Knights with double gold income â€” the payoff for expanding
t3.notes: Castle timing is faster with double gold â€” that's the whole point

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Militia + Scout Towers to defend, pull MK back
Your MK is better in defensive fights â€” just outscale

builds.name: KotG Mountain Giant
builds.description: Keeper of the Grove opener into Mountain Giant tank line. Entangle roots Human heroes, Giants taunt Human armies, and Treant summons provide free reinforcements.
strategyPoints: KotG Entangling Roots roots Human heroes â€” removes Divine Shield timing windows
Mountain Giants have the highest HP of any unit in the game at Tier 3
Giant Taunt forces Human Sorceresses to polymorph their own units if poorly positioned
Force of Nature summons free Treants from enemy trees â€” punishes Human passive play
DH second hero for Manaburn â€” drains AM/MK mana, shuts down their abilities
Wins against: Human AM Rifle builds that rely on kiting, not tanking hits
Loses to: Archmage Blizzard with Mass Teleport that kills Giants before Taunt activates

t1.goal: KotG + Archers, creep with Entangle for free kills

t2.goal: Tree of Ages, Ancient of Lore for Dryads, tech to T3 for Giants

t3.goal: Mountain Giants with Hardened Skin â€” the army anchor
t3.notes: Giants are the entire build's purpose â€” everything else supports them

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Defend with Dryads + Archers, delay until Giants are online
Add Hippogryph Riders â€” Giants can't hit air, you need anti-air

builds.name: DH Standard
builds.description: The standard Night Elf build. Demon Hunter first for Manaburn harassment, fast tech to T3 for Druid of the Claw (bears). Bears in Bear Form have massive HP and Roar aura.
strategyPoints: DH first â€” Manaburn drains enemy hero mana, shutting down their abilities
Immolation provides passive AoE damage â€” good for fast creeping
Fast tech through T2 to T3 â€” the goal is Bears as fast as possible
Druids of the Claw in Bear Form have 960 HP and Roar gives 25% damage aura
KotG second hero for Entangle + Treants â€” lockdown and free reinforcements
Dryads provide Abolish Magic to remove debuffs and Slow Poison for kiting
Wins against: most standard openers across all matchups
Loses to: fast timing pushes that hit during the vulnerable T2 transition

t1.goal: DH + 3-4 Archers, creep aggressively with Immolation

t2.goal: Tree of Ages, Ancient of Lore x2, Dryads while teching to T3

t3.goal: Master Bears â€” Bear Form with Roar and Rejuvenation
t3.notes: Bears are arguably the best T3 unit in the game â€” the entire build leads here

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Keep Dryads to bait Devour Magic, then re-buff Bears
Manaburn the BM â€” he can't harass without mana for Wind Walk

builds.name: DH Mass Talons
builds.description: Demon Hunter into mass Druids of the Talon with Cyclone spam. Exploits Orc's limited dispel options. Cyclone removes key units from fights, Faerie Fire reduces armor.
strategyPoints: DH first for Manaburn â€” drains Blademaster's mana, preventing Wind Walk escapes
Druids of the Talon cast Cyclone â€” removes Grunts and key units from fights for 6 seconds
Mass Cyclone means Orc can never fight at full strength â€” always 2-3 units disabled
Faerie Fire reduces armor and reveals invisible units â€” BM can't hide
Beastmaster from tavern for Quilbeast summons and Stampede ultimate
Orc Spirit Walkers can Ethereal Form to avoid Cyclone â€” but NE can just focus other units
Wins against: Orc melee compositions without heavy dispel
Loses to: FS Headhunter builds that outrange Talons, mass Spirit Walkers

t1.goal: DH + Archers, creep to DH level 3 for Evasion

t2.goal: Ancient of Wind for Druid of the Talon production, start massing Talons

t3.goal: Double Ancient of Wind, Master Talon upgrade for Storm Crow Form
t3.notes: Storm Crow Form lets Talons fly â€” attack and Cyclone from the air

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Mix in Dryads for Abolish Magic, focus fire Spirit Walkers first
Add Mountain Giants â€” Taunt forces Headhunters into melee range

builds.name: DK Gargoyle
builds.description: DK opener into mass Ghouls for lumber, then flood Gargoyles from multiple Crypts. Air superiority overwhelms Orc ground armies. Dark Ranger or Dreadlord third hero for utility.
strategyPoints: DK first with Death Coil â€” creep efficiently, mass Ghouls for lumber harvesting
Delayed T2 (7:00-8:00) because heavy Ghoul investment feeds the Gargoyle transition
Lich second with Frost Nova â€” burst damage on Orc ground clumps
T3 for mass Gargoyle production from double Crypt â€” quantity is key
Dark Ranger third hero for Silence (shuts down Shadow Hunter/TC) and Black Arrow skeletons
Obsidian Statues keep Gargoyles alive through sustained healing
Wins against: Orc ground-heavy builds (Grunts/Raiders) that lack anti-air
Loses to: fast Wind Rider + Batrider transitions that win the air war

t1.goal: DK + mass Ghouls for lumber, creep to level 3

t2.goal: Lich second, begin Gargoyle production, expand if possible

t3.goal: Mass Gargoyles + Statues, Dark Ranger third hero for Silence
t3.notes: Double Crypt Gargoyle production is critical for reaching critical mass

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Add Web upgrade on Fiends, mix in ground anti-air
Keep massing Gargoyles â€” they can't answer air without Batriders or Wind Riders

builds.name: Lich Fast Tech
builds.description: Lich first hero for early Frost Armor tankiness and Frost Nova burst. Slightly defensive opener that creeps with Ghouls and rushes T2 Crypt Fiends. DK as second hero anchors the army at level 6 with Death Coil sustain.
strategyPoints: Lich opener trades creep speed for early magic damage and Frost Armor on Ghouls — survives harassment better than DK first
Frost Nova on tightly packed melee armies is a swing in midgame fights
Skip aggressive level 6 timing — wait until DK is also at 6 to commit
Statues at T2 sustain Lich mana for repeated Frost Nova casts
Good vs HU Archmage Caster: Frost Armor blunts Sorceress Slow + Rifle damage
Wins against: HU caster-heavy openers, slow tech UD mirrors
Loses to: very fast Orc / NE timing pushes that punish slower tech

t1.goal: Lich + 4 Ghouls, creep efficiently with Frost Armor

t2.goal: DK second hero, Statues for sustain, transition into Fiends

t3.goal: Orb of Corruption on DK, Destroyers if facing casters

builds.name: PotM Mass Huntress
builds.description: PotM first hero for Trueshot Aura damage boost and Searing Arrows hero harass. Mass Huntresses provide ranged DPS and Sentinel scout vision. Strong open-map control build.
strategyPoints: PotM Searing Arrows is a powerful early hero-harass tool — trade hits at any creep camp
Trueshot Aura at level 3 buffs all ranged units permanently — Huntresses scale incredibly with it
Sentinel Owl gives free vision at any tree line — abuse for scouting and creep timing
Build Hunter's Hall after first Ancient of War — Moon Glaive upgrade is critical
DH or KotG second hero — DH for harass continuation, KotG for Force of Nature wave
Wins against: Human caster builds (range dominance), NE mirror with DH harass
Loses to: AoE-heavy compositions (Mortar Teams, Destroyers, Frost Nova spam)

t1.goal: PotM + 4-5 Huntresses, control creep camps with Owl scout

t2.goal: Hunter's Hall + Moon Glaive, second hero (DH or KotG), add Dryads

t3.goal: Mountain Giants or Druids of the Talon as situation dictates

builds.name: Paladin Rifle
builds.description: Paladin first hero for Holy Light sustain on early Footmen. Tower up at base, mass Riflemen with Priest support. Defensive opener that scales into a powerful T2 ranged army.
strategyPoints: Holy Light keeps Footmen alive through early creeping and harass — pivotal at low levels
Tower one or two Guard Towers at home before second peasant batch — discourages early aggression
Riflemen production starts around 4:30 — keep all Barracks busy
Priests with Inner Fire double-buff Riflemen damage; Heal sustains the front
Archmage second hero for Brilliance Aura mana sustain on Priests
Wins against: Orc Grunt builds (Holy Light + Towers), NE Bear timing pushes
Loses to: aggressive caster magic (Frost Nova, Faerie Dragon mana burn)

t1.goal: Paladin + 3-4 Footmen, creep with Holy Light heals, tower at home

t3.goal: Spell Breakers or Gryphons depending on opponent composition

builds.name: Crypt Lord Standard
builds.description: Crypt Lord first hero for Carrion Beetles map presence and Impale stun. Ghoul opener like other UD builds, transitions to Crypt Fiends and Statues at T2. Strong vs Night Elf Bears (Impale shuts down DPS) and Human casters (CL tankiness in the front line).
strategyPoints: Carrion Beetles are free creeping units — produce off cooldown, let them tank camps
Spiked Carapace at level 2 — CL becomes the front-line tank, takes Footman/Grunt focus fire
Level 6 Impale stun is decisive on grouped enemy heroes — wait until T2 fight to commit
DK second hero for Death Coil sustain on CL between fights
Statues at T2 keep Beetles + Fiends sustained for repeated engagements
Wins against: NE Bear timing pushes (Impale on bears), HU caster compositions
Loses to: very fast Orc harass that prevents creeping CL to level 3+

t1.goal: CL + 3-4 Ghouls, creep aggressively with Beetles

t2.goal: DK second hero, Fiend transition, Statues for sustain

t3.goal: Orb of Corruption on DK, Destroyers if facing casters

conditionalBranches.condition: Vs NE Demon Hunter timing push
conditionalBranches.adjustment: Skip Orb, push out with CL+DK level 6 + Fiends before Bears
Rush Destroyers to Devour Magic — Sleep on CL is otherwise lethal
